notes.title: 1.1 Content Patch Update + Good news for Corals!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/5fbd86bd7bb63930edad4725e1cd0ea9a6ba9b94.jpg[/img]

Hey! You may have seen Koral got updated. This update brings stability to the game build, adds ultra wide screen support and fixes some minor bugs, including a bugged Steam Achievement. 

Here you can find the complete changelog:

- Fixed Out of Bounds bug in the first section of the cave.

- Fixed Out of Bounds bug in the musical part of "Deeps"

- Fixed achievement bug in "Descent"

- Added ultra wide screen support via commands. ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/896750/discussions/0/1651043958640560312/]see how here[/url])

- Fixed some floating corals in "Garden"

- Added more happiness and colors to some reefs :D

On the other hand, today was a good day: Corals are evolving in some areas of the world to be stronger against climate change, hot temperatures and extreme climate. See more about that here:

https://www.businessinsider.com/scientists-discovered-super-coral-that-has-been-thriving-in-warm-and-acidic-water-in-hawaii-2019-5?IR=T

Big hug,

Carlos.

notes.title: Koral released! 20% Release discount!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/00d52d1afab9fc2666d68d135fbf07b2e4d3db7a.jpg[/img]

Barcelona, May 16 2019.

Hello. My name is Carlos Coronado. I am the game developer behind Koral. I've been working in Koral for about a year now, and today I can at last share the game with you all!

Koral just began available for download just some minutes ago. If you enjoy the ocean, you will enjoy Koral.

ps: Make sure to tell to your diver friend about Koral! :D

ps2: Make sure to take a look at the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UD5eqrRbfDs]Making Of in the sailship[/url] now!

notes.title: The Making of Koral - The game about the sea done in the sea
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/ec7b6ebb6b9385ccceeff611c75c5092d352919c.jpg[/img]

Koral has a really special development. It was done in a sailship in a paradise in northen catalonia called Cap de Creus. What better way to make a game about the sea than going to the sea and make it there!

We recorded the entire process and made a convenient 19 min Making Of for you all to enjoy. You can watch in in youtube. English and Spanish captions avivable.

[h1][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UD5eqrRbfDs]Watch the Making Of the game in YouTube.[/url][/h1]

Kind regards,

Carlos.

notes.title: Dive into the depths of Koral on May 16
notes.notes:
There are few more enticing video game settings than crystal clear underwater glades, and Koral, an explore-o-puzzle game launching next week has them in spades. It s got sort of an Abzu meets Ori And The Blind Forest look, by which I obviously mean, ahhhh, it s all colourful and gorgeous and there are fish friends. Come and dip your toes in the trailer yourself.

notes.title: Send a love letter to the ocean on May 16, 2019.
NEW TRAILER!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

I just uploaded a new trailer to the Steam Page and got rid of the ugly last one! :D

So, what is left to get a release date for Koral? Well, only two things! On one hand the game is already going to certification on Nintendo Switch. As soon as the game pases certification I will be able to give a release date! I want to release at the same time in both systems so that's why going to certification as quickly as posible on Switch is also mandatory for a Steam release!

On the other hand, I am already working on The Making Of Koral, a 30 to 40 min video explaining how Koral was done in a sailboat... with videos from the sailboat! 

Once those two are done, Koral gets released! :D

Oh, and to celebrate, here is a Koral screensaver for you all! :D :D :D

Cheers,

Carlos.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/00d52d1afab9fc2666d68d135fbf07b2e4d3db7a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Video! Main Menu Gameplay! How many species can you spot? :D
notes.notes:
Hi,

Today I've reached a very, VERY important milestone: Content Lock. This means all the content and levels of Koral are done!! So why is the game not released then? 

Well, there is still one last coat of paint to ensure a 100% awesome experience; minor bug fixing, a better collectibles system, Steam achievements integrations, etc, BUT don't get me wrong! We are closer than ever to a Koral release :D :D

To celebrate this milestone I've made a little video showing the Menu of Koral. How many Coral species, plants and animals can you spot? :D

You can watch the video on youtube and twitter. You can also find it in the gamepage videos too (for now)

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VoXv4qpSAEM]Youtube Link[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/CarlosGameDev/status/1094273168850800640]Twitter Link[/url]

notes.title: Koral Making of documentary on a 43 feet boat coming soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33142166/64d52afc95173980edefe213b970864781ccf8ad.jpg[/img]

Hi,

My name is Carlos Coronado, I am a game developer and Koral will be my next released project.

Aside from a good beautiful looking game with puzzle elements I also want to raise awarnesess about the state of Coral reefs around the world, so crucial for the ocean.

4 years ago I started scuba diving while traveling on Koh Tao, Thailand. Since then, I travel to scuba dive! I've been in reefs in Mallorca, Tenerife, Girona, Koh Tao, Coron, El Nido, Palawan, Apo, Komodo, Bali, Lombok and many others and with Koral I want you to transport you to those places, some of them unfortunally are dying.

In the current development state of the game, all the game mechanics are already done and integrated into the Unreal Engine and I have to begin to design levels and the visual narrative of the game. To do so, I had this crazy idea 3 months ago; I am going to invite another 7 game developers to a boat and I am going to design and begin the integration into the Unreal Engine of Koral's levels in the boat while the awesome gamedevs do amazing stuff of their own too! Oh, and not only that. I am also going to record the process and the experience and put it in my youtube channel for everyone to see!

That's why I am inviting you all to subscribe to my youtube channel, link below:

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC3dYTLIQP8eaNUaK8ta1JVA?sub_confirmation=1

The videos will be available before the release of Koral in the next months :)

Feel free to watch the rest of the content too if you want to take a sneak peak of my way of working and developing videogames.

A big hug,

-Carlos.
